states.name: RESET
states.meaning: Synchronous active-high reset forces the four BCD digits to zero and ena to 0 after the rising clock edge.

states.name: COUNT
states.meaning: Four packed BCD digits q[3:0]=ones, q[7:4]=tens, q[11:8]=hundreds, q[15:12]=thousands; the count advances by one modulo 10000 on non-reset clock edges.

rules.condition: At a rising edge of clk, if reset is 1, q is set to 0 and ena is set to 0 after the edge.

At a rising edge of clk with reset 0, the four BCD digits increment by one modulo 10000: d0=q[3:0], d1=q[7:4], d2=q[11:8], d3=q[15:12], with decimal carry when a digit is 9. The value after the edge is the next BCD count. Reset has higher priority when reset is 1.

For current BCD count q, ena[0]=1 iff q[3:0]==9 (tens should increment next); ena[1]=1 iff q[3:0]==9 and q[7:4]==9 (hundreds should increment next); ena[2]=1 iff q[3:0]==9 and q[7:4]==9 and q[11:8]==9 (thousands should increment next); all other ena bits are 0.
rules.spec_quote: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: The first rising edge with reset=0 after reset has been high; q increments from the reset value on that edge.

mid: No mid-cycle input changes are required; reset is sampled before each rising edge.
